$comment: Which dependency updates may merge without a human (docs/engineering/toolchain-policy.md §5). Applied by scripts/dependency-policy.mjs from the base branch, only after every required CI job has passed. Majors are never merged automatically.

highRisk.$comment: Security-sensitive or foundational: every update needs review, patches included.

coreFrameworks.$comment: Actively tracked frameworks and toolchain: patches may merge automatically; minors need review.

reviewEcosystems.$comment: Workflow actions run with repository credentials: always reviewed.
